newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS SELLS STAKE IN GERMAN BANK BEHNCKE.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS SELLS STAKE IN GERMAN BANK BEHNCKE.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Tuesday it was in talks to sell its 44 percent stake in Germany's Bankgeschaeft Heinrich Behncke GmbH.
The negotiations were in an advanced stage, Philips added.
Earlier today it announced it had agreed to sell its 34.2 percent stake in specialised bank Mendes Gans to ING and its fully-owned unit Philips Financial Services Ltd to Britain's Avco Trust Ltd.
Philips said the total positive cashflow from the three deals would be over 200 million guilders. It decided to sell the stakes in the financial firms to focus on its core activities.
